e.title: IIA（国际内部审计师协会）：2024 全球内部审计准则、审计委员会中心与 COSO 框架
e.title_en: The IIA (Institute of Internal Auditors): the 2024 Global Internal Audit Standards, an audit committee centre and COSO resources
e.title_hk: IIA（國際內部審計師協會）：2024 全球內部審計準則、審計委員會中心與 COSO 框架
e.summary: 全球内部审计职业组织：发布 2024 全球内部审计准则及专题要求与全球指引，设全球审计委员会中心、COSO 内部控制资源、内部审计能力框架与纪律监督栏目，并提供学生会员与多语译文检索
e.summary_en: The global internal audit professional body: it publishes the 2024 Global Internal Audit Standards with topical requirements and global guidance, runs a Global Audit Committee Center, COSO internal-control resources, an internal audit competency framework and a discipline and oversight section, and offers student membership and a translated-content search
e.summary_hk: 全球內部審計職業組織：發布 2024 全球內部審計準則及專題要求與全球指引，設全球審計委員會中心、COSO 內部控制資源、內部審計能力框架與紀律監督欄目，並提供學生會員與多語譯文檢索
e.body:
**IIA（The Institute of Internal Auditors，国际内部审计师协会）** 是**全球内部审计职业组织**（站点标题实测 **「The Institute of Internal Auditors | The IIA」**）。本条目补的是**「第三道防线的机构层」**——⭐ **口径必须写明**：**池内已有 [[three-lines-of-defense]]（三道防线）这一概念条目**，**但「内部审计这一职业与准则的机构」此前为 0**；**即「有三道防线的概念，没有第三道防线的机构」**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：⭐ **「2024 Global Internal Audit Standards（2024 全球内部审计准则）」页 `/en/standards/2024-standards/global-internal-audit-standards/` 实测 78.7KB，标题逐字「2024 Global Internal Audit Standards | The IIA」**；⭐ **「Global Audit Committee Center（全球审计委员会中心）」页 `/en/resources/global-audit-committee-center/` 实测 94.1KB，标题「Global Audit Committee Center | Internal Audit Oversight」**；⭐ **「COSO Resources from The IIA」页 `/en/resources/coso/` 实测 76.9KB**；**站点首页 98.5KB**。**导航与链接逐字实测揭示的结构**：**IPPF & Standards** 下含 ⭐ **Global Internal Audit Standards**、⭐ **Topical Requirements（专题要求）**、⭐ **Global Guidance（全球指引）**、**Audit Tools**、⭐ **Governance Process and Due Diligence**、**documents**；**Membership** 下含 ⭐ **Student Membership & Resources**、Executive Membership、Group Membership 等；**Ethics & Professionalism（道德与职业性）**；**Resources** 下含 **Statements of Position**、**Knowledge Centers**、⭐ **Internal Audit Competency Framework（内部审计能力框架）**、**Research and Reports**、⭐ **Translated Content Search（译文内容检索）**；**About us** 下含 **About Internal Audit**、**Advocacy**、⭐ **Discipline and Oversight（纪律与监督）**、⭐ **Academic Relations（学术关系）**、**Chapters and Affiliates**、**Licensing**；另有会刊站点 **`internalauditor.theiia.org`**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「第三道防线」的机构与准则层**——**池内 [[three-lines-of-defense]] 讲的是「三道防线如何分工」，而 IIA 提供的是第三道防线**自己的准则、能力框架与职业纪律**；**对做保险公司治理或内部审计方向的学生，这是一个可直接查准则的职业入口**（**可与 [[insurance-governance]]、[[cro-forum]]、同轮 [[igln]] 并读——**四者分别对应「治理概念 / CRO 层 / 董事会层 / 内部审计层」**）。**② ⭐⭐ 「2024 全球内部审计准则」是**全球统一的内部审计准则**（**本次未打开正文，故不转述其条款、编号或生效安排**），**并有配套的「专题要求」与「全球指引」三层结构**——**这是「准则 → 专题要求 → 指引」的三级体系，与池内 [[aae]] 的「国际原则 → 欧洲准则 → 国家标准」、[[assal]] 的「国际标准 / 自有标准 / 成员国法规」同为多层规则体系，但层级逻辑不同**。**③ ⭐ 「全球审计委员会中心」是**面向审计委员会**的资源**——**与同轮 [[igln]] 的「Audit & Control」焦点领域正好衔接：一个是董事侧平台、一个是职业侧资源中心**；**对做审计委员会或董事会治理研究的学生，这是一个少见的「面向委员会而非面向执行层」的资源**（**本次未打开内容**）。**④ ⭐⭐ 「COSO 资源」值得单独注意**——**COSO 内部控制框架是「三道防线」概念的近邻框架**（**COSO 讲内部控制，三道防线讲组织分工**）；**池内此前没有 COSO 的机构入口**，**本条目把它补上**（**本次未打开 COSO 内容，故不转述框架要素**）。**⑤ 「学生会员与资源」与「学术关系」对本站读者直接相关**——**一个职业组织同时对学生与学术界设专门入口**，**对考虑内部审计职业路径的 RIAA 毕业生是可用信息**（**本次未打开条件**）。**⑥ 「译文内容检索」栏目对非英语读者有实际价值**（**本次仅核实栏目存在，未核实语种**）。**⑦ 「纪律与监督」栏目与池内 [[abcd]]（精算职业纪律）同属「职业自律的纪律一侧」**——**两者并读可见不同职业的纪律机制设计**。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页与三个页面的存在、标题、页面体量、以及导航逐字实测的准则、资源、会员与机构栏目结构**，**但未打开准则正文、未打开专题要求或全球指引、未打开审计委员会中心、COSO 资源、能力框架、纪律与监督、学术关系或任何译文内容**，因此**不能转述任何准则条款与编号、COSO 框架要素、能力框架条目、纪律案例、会员条件或译文语种**；**② ⭐ 「2024 全球内部审计准则」**为页面标题逐字实测**，**但其正式生效日期、版本结构、是否与各国准则并行本次未核实**——**词条内不主张其适用范围或强制力**；**③ 「三级体系（准则 / 专题要求 / 全球指引）」依据栏目并列关系**，**本次未打开任何一页说明三者的相互效力关系**；**④ ⭐ 「COSO 内部控制框架」这一表述依据页面标题「COSO Resources from The IIA」**——**COSO 的全称、与 IIA 的组织关系、以及该页究竟提供什么内容，本次均未核实**，**故词条内只写「COSO 资源（COSO 内部控制资源）」并在此标注推断成分**；**⑤ IIA 的会员规模、成立年份与治理结构本次未核实**；**⑥ 是否提供中文准则本次未核实**（**虽有 Translated Content Search 栏目**）；**⑦** 本词条**不主张** IIA 提供精算工具、定价模型或保险数据**。**核实说明**：`/en/standards/2024-standards/global-internal-audit-standards/`（78.7KB）、`/en/resources/global-audit-committee-center/`（94.1KB）、`/en/resources/coso/`（76.9KB）与首页（98.5KB）均经**缓冲区安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取标题与导航；**未打开准则正文、专题要求、全球指引、审计委员会中心、COSO 资源、能力框架、纪律页、学术关系页或任何译文内容**。
e.body_en:
**The IIA (Institute of Internal Auditors)** is **the global internal audit professional body** (measured site title **"The Institute of Internal Auditors | The IIA"**). This entry adds the **"institutional layer of the third line of defence"** — ⭐ **and the scope must be stated**: **the corpus already holds the concept [[three-lines-of-defense]]**, **but the institution representing the internal audit profession and its standards measured zero**; **i.e. the concept of three lines existed, the third line’s institution did not**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): ⭐ the **"2024 Global Internal Audit Standards" page measures 78.7KB with the measured title "2024 Global Internal Audit Standards | The IIA"**; ⭐ the **"Global Audit Committee Center" page measures 94.1KB with the measured title "Global Audit Committee Center | Internal Audit Oversight"**; ⭐ the **"COSO Resources from The IIA" page measures 76.9KB**; the **homepage is 98.5KB**. **Structure read verbatim from navigation and links**: under **IPPF & Standards** — ⭐ **Global Internal Audit Standards**, ⭐ **Topical Requirements**, ⭐ **Global Guidance**, **Audit Tools**, ⭐ **Governance Process and Due Diligence** and **documents**; under **Membership** — ⭐ **Student Membership & Resources**, Executive Membership and Group Membership; **Ethics & Professionalism**; under **Resources** — **Statements of Position**, **Knowledge Centers**, ⭐ **Internal Audit Competency Framework**, **Research and Reports** and ⭐ **Translated Content Search**; under **About us** — **About Internal Audit**, **Advocacy**, ⭐ **Discipline and Oversight**, ⭐ **Academic Relations**, **Chapters and Affiliates** and **Licensing**; plus a magazine site at **`internalauditor.theiia.org`**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the institution and standards layer of the third line of defence** — **[[three-lines-of-defense]] explains how the lines divide their work, whereas the IIA supplies the third line’s own standards, competency framework and professional discipline**; **for students working on insurer governance or internal audit, this is a directly checkable professional entry point** (**readable with [[insurance-governance]], [[cro-forum]] and [[igln]] in the same round — four layers: governance concept, CRO, board, internal audit**). **② ⭐⭐ The 2024 Global Internal Audit Standards are **globally uniform internal audit standards** (**the text was not opened, so no clause, number or effective-date arrangement is restated**), **with a two-tier companion structure of topical requirements and global guidance** — **a three-level system of standards → topical requirements → guidance, structurally comparable with [[aae]]’s "international principles → European standards → national standards" and [[assal]]’s "international standards / own standards / member-country regulation", but with different tier logic**. **③ ⭐ The Global Audit Committee Center is a resource aimed at the audit committee** — **connecting directly with the "Audit & Control" focus area of [[igln]] in the same round: one a director-side platform, one a profession-side resource centre**; **a rare resource aimed at a committee rather than at the executive layer** (**content not opened**). **④ ⭐⭐ The COSO resources deserve separate note** — **the COSO internal control framework is the close neighbour of the three-lines concept** (**COSO addresses internal control; three lines addresses organisational division of labour**); **the corpus previously had no institutional entry point for COSO**, **and this entry adds it** (**the COSO content was not opened, so no framework element is restated**). **⑤ Student membership and resources, and academic relations, are directly relevant to this wiki’s readers** — **a professional body running dedicated entry points for students and academia**, **usable information for RIAA graduates considering internal audit** (**conditions not opened**). **⑥ The translated-content search section has practical value for non-English readers** (**only its existence was verified, not the languages**). **⑦ The discipline and oversight section belongs with [[abcd]] (actuarial professional discipline) as the "discipline side" of professional self-regulation** — **reading both shows how different professions design their disciplinary mechanisms**.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage and three pages’ existence, titles and sizes, and the standards, resources, membership and institutional structure read verbatim from navigation**, **but opened no standards text, no topical requirement or global guidance, no audit committee centre, no COSO resource, no competency framework, no discipline page, no academic relations page and no translated content**, so **no standard clause or number, COSO framework element, competency item, disciplinary case, membership condition or translated language can be restated**; **② ⭐ "2024 Global Internal Audit Standards" is read verbatim from the page title**, **but its effective date, version structure and whether it runs in parallel with national standards were not verified** — **the entry claims no scope or binding force**; **③ the "three-level system" rests on the parallel listing of those sections**, **and no page explaining their relative authority was opened**; **④ ⭐ The phrase "COSO internal control framework" rests on the page title "COSO Resources from The IIA"** — **COSO’s full name, its organisational relationship to the IIA, and what the page actually provides were all unverified**, **so the entry says only "COSO resources" and flags the inferential component here**; **⑤ the IIA’s membership size, founding year and governance were not verified**; **⑥ whether Chinese standards are available was not verified** (**despite the Translated Content Search section**); **⑦** this entry **does not claim the IIA provides actuarial tools, pricing models or insurance data**. **Verification note**: `/en/standards/2024-standards/global-internal-audit-standards/` (78.7KB), `/en/resources/global-audit-committee-center/` (94.1KB), `/en/resources/coso/` (76.9KB) and the homepage (98.5KB) were measured at HTTP 200 using the **buffer-safe probe tool `discovery/probe-urls.sh`**, with titles and navigation read verbatim; **no standards text, topical requirement, global guidance, audit committee centre, COSO resource, competency framework, discipline page, academic relations page or translated content was opened**.
e.body_hk:
**IIA（The Institute of Internal Auditors，國際內部審計師協會）** 是**全球內部審計職業組織**（站點標題實測 **「The Institute of Internal Auditors | The IIA」**）。本條目補的是**「第三道防線的機構層」**——⭐ **口徑必須寫明**：**池內已有 [[three-lines-of-defense]]（三道防線）這一概念條目**，**但「內部審計這一職業與準則的機構」此前為 0**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：⭐ **「2024 Global Internal Audit Standards」頁 78.7KB**；⭐ **「Global Audit Committee Center」頁 94.1KB**；⭐ **「COSO Resources from The IIA」頁 76.9KB**；首頁 98.5KB。**導航與連結逐字實測**：**IPPF & Standards** 下含 **Global Internal Audit Standards／Topical Requirements／Global Guidance／Audit Tools／Governance Process and Due Diligence**；**Membership** 含 ⭐**Student Membership & Resources**；**Ethics & Professionalism**；**Resources** 含 **Statements of Position／Knowledge Centers／⭐Internal Audit Competency Framework／Research and Reports／⭐Translated Content Search**；**About us** 含 **About Internal Audit／Advocacy／⭐Discipline and Oversight／⭐Academic Relations／Chapters and Affiliates／Licensing**；另有會刊站點 **`internalauditor.theiia.org`**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「第三道防線」的機構與準則層**——**[[three-lines-of-defense]] 講分工，IIA 提供第三道防線**自己的準則、能力框架與職業紀律**（可與 [[insurance-governance]]、[[cro-forum]]、同輪 [[igln]] 並讀——**四者對應「治理概念／CRO 層／董事會層／內部審計層」**）。**② ⭐⭐ 「2024 全球內部審計準則」是**全球統一的內部審計準則**（**未打開正文，故不轉述條款與編號**），**並有「專題要求」與「全球指引」兩層配套**——**是「準則 → 專題要求 → 指引」的三級體系**。**③ ⭐ 「全球審計委員會中心」是**面向審計委員會**的資源**——**與同輪 [[igln]] 的「Audit & Control」焦點領域正好銜接**（**未打開內容**）。**④ ⭐⭐ 「COSO 資源」值得單獨注意**——**COSO 內部控制框架是「三道防線」的近鄰框架**；**池內此前沒有 COSO 的機構入口**（**未打開 COSO 內容，故不轉述框架要素**）。**⑤ 「學生會員與資源」與「學術關係」對本站讀者直接相關**。**⑥ 「譯文內容檢索」欄目對非英語讀者有實際價值**（**僅核實欄目存在，未核實語種**）。**⑦ 「紀律與監督」與池內 [[abcd]] 同屬「職業自律的紀律一側」**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**首頁與三個頁面的存在、標題、體量、導航逐字實測的結構**，**但未打開準則正文、專題要求、全球指引、審計委員會中心、COSO 資源、能力框架、紀律頁、學術關係頁或任何譯文內容**，故**不能轉述任何準則條款與編號、COSO 框架要素、能力框架條目、紀律案例、會員條件或譯文語種**；**② ⭐ 「2024 全球內部審計準則」為頁面標題逐字實測**，**但其生效日期、版本結構、是否與各國準則並行未核實**——**不主張其適用範圍或強制力**；**③ 「三級體系」依據欄目並列關係，未打開任何一頁說明其效力關係**；**④ ⭐ 「COSO 內部控制框架」這一表述依據頁面標題**——**COSO 全稱、與 IIA 的組織關係、以及該頁究竟提供什麼內容均未核實**，**故只寫「COSO 資源」並在此標註推斷成分**；**⑤ 會員規模、成立年份與治理結構未核實**；**⑥ 是否提供中文準則未核實**；**⑦** 本詞條**不主張** IIA 提供精算工具、定價模型或保險數據**。**核實說明**：四個 URL 均經**緩衝區安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 實測並逐字讀取標題與導航；**未打開準則正文、專題要求、全球指引、審計委員會中心、COSO 資源、能力框架、紀律頁、學術關係頁或任何譯文內容**。
